Facilities
Library
The modern computerized Library has more than Thirty thousand volume of books covering various areas of computer sciences, Life Science and Arts. It has subscriptions of three hundred journals. The Audio-Visual Centre & CD-ROM Workstation has an impressive collection of thousands of video cassettes & CD-ROMs. The Computerized catalogue could be accessed in the library.
Language Lab
The institution has an English Communication Lab with the prime objectives for developing the four major skills among the students.
They are: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Hostel
The B.Sc.(Ag.) degree girls students are accommodated in girls hostel inside TRIARD campus. The boy’s students are accommodated in Roever Engineering Hostel which is 2 Km away from TRIARD campus.
Admission Procedures
Mess
Application for admission to the hostel along with prescribed form can be had from the office on payment. A student seeking admission should be accompanied by his parent/authorized Guardian and only after an interview by the Principal / Warden he/she will be given admission. 

Admission will depend on the decision of the Management. A senior student wishing to be re-admitted shall apply again in the prescribed form after meeting the Deputy Warden with the Parent / Guardian.  Dismissal or suspension of a member from the College will involve automatic dismissal or suspension from the hostel, such students shall not enter the hostel without the permission of the Principal. 

Students admitted to the hostel will not be allowed to stay outside the college during the period of their course. 
The Managing authorities have the right to terminate the membership of the hostel, for breach of discipline or any grave offence even in the middle of the academic year.
The mess is run on a fixed rate per day basis.

Inmates of the hostel are not allowed to enter the kitchen premises. Complaints and suggestions about food or service must be made to the Deputy warden in a proper manner.

They should conduct themselves decently in the dining hall.

The following timings shall be observed strictly by the inmates.
Breakfast :
7.00 a.m. to 7.30 a.m
Lunch :
12.30 p.m. to 1.00p.m
Dinner :
7.30 p.m. to 8.30 p.m
Sports & Games
The Volleyball team of TRIARD participated in the Inter-Collegiate Tournament at TNAU Coimbatore on 2018. our students enter in the semi-final
Fifteen students participated in the selection Trials for AGRIUNISPORTS, 2018 held at TNAU Coimbatore.
Compulsory Physical Activity was followed for first and second-year B.Sc.,(Hons) Agriculture students between 5.30 and 6.30 PM every day wherein warm-up practice was followed by other games
The students of TRIARD participated in the ICT, Cricket Zonal level matches at RVS Agricultural college Thanjavur, Our team has got runner up position in this event
The students of TRIARD participated in the CM Trophy 2018 at Perambalur. And our students placed in the First position in the summing event and runner up position in Ball Badminton game
Twenty-five students of TRIARD Participated in the Trichy Marathon during 2018 for the theme of World Health Day.
Independence Day Sports meet was held on 15.08.2018 in which students participated on a friendly basis
The TRIARD Sports Day was conducted between April 9, 2018, The sports day was presided over by Mr.M.Subramaniyaraja, District Sports Officer, Perambalur as Chief Guest. In total 333 prizes were distributed during the Sports meet
TRIARD Students participated in Swami Vivekananda trophy Volleyball, Kabaddi Tournament at Ramakrishna Mission Coimbatore on Mar 08.03.2019 and 09.03.2019
Fifty-two students of Boys and Girls of TRIARD participated SPORAG 2018 in Annamalai University and played games like Volleyball (men and women), Football(men), and Basketball(men and women).
Rural sports like sack race, blind man’s bluff were conducted along with lucky corner, Rope pulling, slow cycle race, running, bucketing the ball were conducted form labourers during the Pongal Day celebration
Kabaddi, Volleyball, and Badminton courts were created nearby Girls hostel for girls students practices that games
Yoga class is being conducted regularly for both boys and girls for degree students.
World Yoga Day was celebrated on 21.06.2018. Mr Karuppaiya senior Professor of Vedathiri Maharishi Foundation delivered a lecture on the Importance of Yoga.
A Table Tennis court with all specifications marking, playing area is created in TRIARD Perambalur
Two carom boards and two chess boards were purchased and available of hostel students indoor leisure activity

Internet
The Institution is having a fully equipped Computer Centre with 120 Pentium IV. Beside the Curriculum, Auto CAD, Hardware Servicing & Maintenance, C, C++, MS-Office 2000, 10 Mbps speed of Internet Usage and Wi-fi connections facilities for all students.
Apart from the computer laboratories setup for syllabus programs the Institutes have provided computer centres for general purposes and learning during extra hours. This includes Internet Facilities available through leased line and Wi-Fi for providing continuous and uninterrupted internet connectivity to students and faculty members. These facilities are also available to students beyond college hours for preparation of seminars & projects and research-orientated work.

Transport
Transport Facilities provided 6 buses to the students for all outdoor classes in connection to their syllabus.
About Us
Thanthai Roever Institute of Agriculture and Rural Development (TRIARD), one of the Roever Group of Educational Institution, which is run by run by the St. John Sangam Trust, was started to offer courses in Diploma in Agriculture during the year 1994, later Diploma in Horticulture on 2001 and B.Sc.(Agri) in 2008.
